scope: Stage B slice 1: one ordinary-observation verdict for state and EMS plus matching overview, screen, energy-flow and assistant presentation

server.module: internal/ems/observation returns usable/stale/invalid/unknown, signal quality, reason, source/received time and expires_at
server.state: state.effective consumes the verdict; rules and alarms inherit it through State.Samples
server.ems_state: quality and expires_at come from the same observation input instead of separate SourceTime.Add logic
server.no_expiry: MaxAge=0 returns unknown with expiry_unconfigured and no expires_at
server.boundary: exact expiry remains usable; only a later time becomes stale/source_expired

frontend.module: describeObservation consumes expires_at and never leaves an expired observation with reason 数据有效
frontend.node_adapter: observationForNode maps Modbus parent/server identity and returns unknown for non-EMS nodes
frontend.pages: ScreenView, App stalePoints, EnergyFlow and AssistantPanel no longer use local 15-second freshness checks
frontend.unknown: Unconfigured freshness is labeled unknown/未声明有效期 and is not counted as stale
frontend.health_summary: Zero confirmed-stale points uses neutral wording and never claims all points are fresh when state is unknown, loading or unreadable

verification.go_full: go test -p 1 -count=1 ./... passed (35 packages, including the new observation package)
verification.http: A local Modbus simulator produced quality=good with expires_at; after polling was disabled without another attempt, the same point became stale/source_expired
verification.browser: The running screen showed 过期 for the Modbus point and 状态未知 for a non-EMS variable; EnergyFlow showed 状态未知; the assistant reported 1 个已过期 and 2 个新鲜度不可确认
verification.cleanup: Simulator and UI server stopped; temporary channel, variable and screen selection were removed or restored
verification.review: Independent review found the zero-stale overview could claim health for unknown observations; staleSummaryText now returns neutral wording after a RED→GREEN consumer check

deferred_minors: EnergyFlow, AssistantPanel and ScreenView have real-browser acceptance but no additional automated component-level tests
remaining_stage_b: Adapt calculation ValidUntil and virtual-input Epoch/TTL semantics without conflating them with ordinary observations
Unify channel link-health verdicts for delivery, preflight, allocator and alarm monitoring
limits: No production device connection or physical write
No calculation ValidUntil or virtual-input Epoch/TTL behavior changes
No link-health changes in this slice
